edges.reason: msg.sender is read to initialize owner in the Owned constructor.
Constructor writes owner = msg.sender at deployment.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before transferOwnership executes.
owner state variable gates the transferOwnership privilege check.
_newOwner parameter is stored into newOwner.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before changing ownership.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner to owner, changing privileged authority.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
_totalSupply is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply.
balances[address(0)] is an operand of the unchecked subtraction in totalSupply.
totalSupply performs a raw uint subtraction without SafeMath protection.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
tokenOwner parameter is used to index the balances mapping.
transfer calls safeSub to decrement the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd to increment the recipient balance.
msg.sender identifies the debited account inside transfer.
tokens parameter flows into the balance arithmetic of transfer.
to parameter is the credited account in transfer.
transfer writes updated values into the balances mapping.
approve writes the allowance into the allowed mapping.
spender parameter is used as the allowance key in approve.
tokens parameter is stored as the approved allowance.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
transferFrom calls safeSub for both balance and allowance deduction.
transferFrom calls safeAdd to credit the recipient.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter drives the balance arithmetic in transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the spender key when reducing the allowance.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall executes an external call to the caller-supplied spender contract.
spender parameter becomes the target of the external call.
tokens parameter is stored as allowance and passed to the callee.
arbitrary data parameter is forwarded to the external callee.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approveAndCall.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
The external call invokes receiveApproval on an untrusted contract, enabling reentrancy.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract.
tokenAddress parameter is an arbitrary external call target.
tokens parameter is forwarded to the external transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token sends swept tokens to the privileged owner address.
a parameter feeds the checked addition in safeAdd.
b parameter feeds the checked addition in safeAdd.
safeAdd computes c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
safeSub computes c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
a parameter feeds the checked subtraction in safeSub.
b parameter feeds the checked subtraction in safeSub.
safeMul computes c = a * b with an overflow require.
safeDiv computes c = a / b with a non-zero divisor require.
msg.sender-derived balance values are passed into safeSub during transfer.
